s.d: ἁδρότης, -τος, ἡ (ἁδρός, thick, well-grown), 1. thickness, vigour. 2. abundance, bounty: [[2-corinthians 8 20|2Co.8:20.]] † (AS)

ἀδυνατέω, -ῶ (ἀδύνατος), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 17 8|Deu.17:8]], [[zechariah 8 6|Zec.8:6]] (פּלא ni.), [[job 42 2|Job.42:2]] (בּצר ni.), al. ;] 1. Abbott-Smith omits this number to be unable (cl., Philo; π., see MM, VGT, see word). 2. In LXX and NT (Kennedy, Sources, 124; Hatch, Essays, 4; Field, Notes, 46 f.), to be impossible: [[matthew 17 20|Mat.17:20]], [[luke 1 37|Luk.1:37]]. † (AS)

ἀ-δύνατος, -ον, [in LXX for אֶבְיוֹן, דַּל, etc. ;] 1. of persons, unable, powerless: [[acts 14 8|Act.14:8;]] figuratively [[romans 15 1|Rom.15:1]] (MM, VGT, see word). 2. Of things, impossible: [[matthew 19 26|Mat.19:26]], [[mark 10 27|Mrk.10:27]], [[luke 18 27|Luk.18:27]], [[romans 8 3|Rom.8:3]], [[hebrews 6 4|Heb.6:4,18 10:4 11:6]]. † (AS)

ᾄδω (Attic form of Ion. and poët. ἀείδω), [in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר ;] to sing, (a) intrans., with dative (MM, VGT, see word), of praise to God: [[ephesians 5 19|Eph.5:19]], [[colossians 3 16|Col.3:16]] ; (b) trans., with cogn. accusative: ᾠδὴν, [[revelation 5 9|Rev.5:9 14:3 15:3]]. † (AS)

ἀεί, adv., [in LXX: [[isaiah 42 14|Isa.42:14]] (מֵעוֹלָם) 51:13 (תָּמִיד), [[psalms 95 10|Ps 94(95):10]], al. ;] ever; 1. of continuous time, unceasingly, perpetually: [[acts 7 51|Act.7:51]], [[2-corinthians 4 11|2 Co.4.11; 6:10]], [[titus 1 12|Tit.1:12]], [[hebrews 3 10|Heb.3:10]]. 2. Of successive occurrences, on every occasion (MM, VGT, see word): [[1-peter 3 15|1Pe.3:15]], [[2-peter 1 12|2Pe.1:12]]. † (AS)

ἀετός, -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX for נֶשֶׁר ;] an eagle: [[revelation 4 7|Rev.4:7 8:13]] (Rec. ἀγγέλου) 12:14. Where carrion is referred to, ἀ. is probably a vulture (cf. [[job 39 30|Job.39:30]], [[proverbs 30 17|Pro.30:17]]): [[matthew 24 28|Mat.24:28]], [[luke 17 37|Luk.17:37]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἄζυμος, -ον (ζύμη), [in LXX for מָצָּה; τὰ ἄ. (sc. λάγανα, cakes) = הַמָצָּה ;] unleavened: ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἄ. (הַג הַמָצָּה), the paschal feast (also called τὰ ἄ., [[mark 14 1|Mrk.14:1]]), [[luke 22 1|Luk.22:1]]; ἡμέρα τῶν ἄ., [[matthew 26 17|Mat.26:17]], [[mark 14 12|Mrk.14:12]], [[luke 22 7|Luk.22:7]]; ἡμέραι, [[acts 12 3|Act.12:3 20:6]]. Fig., of Christians, free from corruption: [[1-corinthians 5 7|1Co.5:7;]] exhorted to keep festival, ἐν ἀζύμοις (sc. ἄρτοις, λάγανοις, or, indefinitely, "unleavened elements"), ib. 8 (Cremer, 724).† (AS)
Ἀζώρ, ὁ, indecl., Azor: [[matthew 1 13|Mat.1:13,14]].† (AS)
Ἄζωτος, -ου, ἡ (Heb., אַשְׁדּוֹד), Azotus, a Philistine city: [[acts 8 40|Act.8:40.]]† (AS)

ἀήρ, ἀέρος, ὁ, [in LXX: [[2-kings 22 12|2Ki.22:12]] (= Psa.17(18):11 שׁחק), Wi .8 ;] in Hom., Hes., the lower air which surrounds the earth, as opposite to the purer αἰθήρ of the higher regions; generally, air (MM, VGT, see word): [[acts 22 23|Act.22:23]], [[1-thessalonians 4 17|1Th.4:17]], [[revelation 9 2|Rev.9:2 16:17]]; of the air as the realm of demons, [[ephesians 2 2|Eph.2:2;]] ἀ. δέρειν, of striving to no purpose, [[1-corinthians 9 26|1Co.9:26;]] εἰς ἀ. λαλεῖν, of speaking without effect, not being understood, [[1-corinthians 14 9|1Co.14:9.]]† (AS)

ἀθανασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀ-θάνατος, undying; V. MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Wis.3:4 4:1 8:13,17 15:3, 4Ma.14:5 16:13 * ;] immortality: [[1-corinthians 15 53|1Co.15:53,54]] [[1-timothy 6 16|1Ti.6:16]] (cf. Cremer, 285 f.).† (AS)

ἀ-θέμιτος (late form of ἀθέμιστος, LS, MM, VGT, see word), -ον (θέμις, custom, right), [in LXX: 2Ma.6:5 7:1 10:34, 3Ma.5:20 * ;] (a) of persons, lawless (III Mac, l.with); (b) of things, lawless, unlawful: [[acts 10 28|Act.10:28]], [[1-peter 4 3|1Pe.4:3]].† SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος. (AS)

ἄ-θεος, -ον, 1. in cl. (a) slighting or denyiyig the gods (Plat.; cf. MM, VGT, see word); (b) godless, ungodly (Pind.); (with) abandoned by the gods (Soph.) 2. In the NT (cf. Lft. on Ign. ad Trail, §3), of the heathen, without God, not knowing God (Cremer, 281): [[ephesians 2 12|Eph.2:12.]] † (AS)

ἄθεσμος, -ον (θεσμός, law, custom), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:12 6:26 * ;] lawless, esp. of those who violate the law of nature and conscience (cf. MM, VGT, see word): [[2-peter 2 7|2Pe.2:7 3:17]].† SYN.: ἀθέμιτος, ἄνομος, κακός, πονηρός, φαῦλος (see Tr., Syn., §lxxiv; DCG, ii, 821b). (AS)

ἀθετέω, -ῶ (τίθημι), [in LXX for seventeen different words, פּשׁע, מרד, בּגד, מעל, etc., often meaning, as [[1-samuel 13 3|1Ki.13:3]] (Heb., al.), to revolt; properly, to make ἄθετον , or do away with what has been laid down (see DCG, i, 453 f.)]. 1. to set aside, disregard (in Gramm., to reject as spurious): διαθήκην , [[galatians 3 16|Gal.3:16;]] ἐντολήν , [[mark 7 9|Mrk.7:9;]] νόμον . [[hebrews 10 28|Heb.10:28;]] πίστιν , [[1-timothy 5 12|1Ti.5:12.]] 2. to nullify, make void: [[luke 7 30|Luk.7:30]] (see Field, Notes, 59), [[1-corinthians 1 19|1Co.1:19]], [[galatians 2 21|Gal.2:21]]. 3. to reject: [[mark 6 26|Mrk.6:26]] (Field, op. cit., 30), [[luke 10 16|Lk 10:16]], [[john 12 48|Jhn.12:48]], I Th 48, Ju 8 (for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

ἀθέτησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀθετέω), [in LXX, usually of unfaithful, rebellious action: [[1-samuel 24 12|1Ki.24:12]] (פֶּשַׁע), [[jeremiah 12 1|Jer.12:1]] (בֶּגֶד), [[daniel 9 7|Da TH 9:7]] (מַעַל), 2Ma.14:28 * ;] a disannulling, setting aside: [[hebrews 7 18|Heb.7:18 9:26]] (for similar usage in π., see Deiss., BS, 228 f.; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
Ἀθῆναι, -ῶν, αἱ (plural because consisting of several parts), Athens: [[acts 17 15|Act.17:15,16 18:1]], [[1-thessalonians 3 1|1Th.3:1]].† (AS)
Athenian, of or from Athens , (Iliad by Homer), etc (ML)
ἀθλέω, -ῶ (in cl. also ἀθλεύω, ἆθλος, a contest, in war or in sport), to contend in games, wrestle, combat: [[2-timothy 2 5|2Ti.2:5.]]† (AS)
ἄθλησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀθλέω), a contest, combat, esp. of athletes; figuratively, a struggle: [[hebrews 10 32|Heb.10:32]] (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀθυμέω, -ῶ (ἄ-θυμος, without heart), [in LXX for חרה, etc. ;] to be disheartened: [[colossians 3 21|Col.3:21.]]† (AS)

ἀθῷος (Rec. wrongly, -ῶος; LS, see word; Mayser, 131), -ον (θωή, a penalty), [in LXX chiefly for נקה ni., pi., נָקִי ;] 1. unpunished (MM, VGT, see word). 2. innocent: [[matthew 27 4|Mat.27:4]] (WH, R, mg., δίκαιον) 27:24. (AS)
αἴγειος (WH, -γιος), -α, -ον (αἶξ, a goat), [in LXX for עֵז ;] of a goat: [[hebrews 11 37|Heb.11:37]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

αἰγιαλός, -οῦ, ὁ (on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word), [in LXX: [[judges 5 17|Jdg.5:17]] (חוֹף), Sir.24:14 * ;] the sea-shore, beach (cf. Field, Notes, 146; DCG, i, 175 f.; MM, VGT, see word): [[matthew 13 2|Mat.13:2,48]] [[john 21 4|Jhn.21:4]], [[acts 21 5|Act.21:5 27:39,40]].† (AS)
Αἰγύπτιος, -α, ον, Egyptian: [[acts 7 22|Act.7:22,24,28 21:38]], [[hebrews 11 29|Heb.11:29]].† (AS)

Αἴγυπτος, ου, ἡ, Egypt: [[matthew 2 13|Mat.2:13-15,19]], [[acts 2 10|Act.2:10 7:9-39]], [[hebrews 3 16|Heb.3:16 11:26,27]]; γῆ Αἴ., [[acts 7 40|Act.7:40 13:17]], [[hebrews 8 9|Heb.8:9]], Ju 5 (cf. [[exodus 5 12|Exo.5:12]], al.); ἡ Αἴ., [[acts 7 11|Act.7:11;]] figuratively, of Jerusalem as hostile to God, [[revelation 11 8|Rev.11:8.]]† (AS)

ἀΐδιος, -ον (ἀεί), [in LXX: Wis.7:26, 4Ma.10:15 * ;] everlasting (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word): [[romans 1 20|Rom.1:20]], Ju 6.† SYN.: αἰώνιος, also frequently in Inscr. (Deiss., BS, 363 J. The etymological distinction between the meanings of the two words seems not to be retained in late Greek (see Thayer, see word, αἰώνιος; cf. Cremer, 79, 611). (AS)

αἰδώς (-όος), -οῦς, ἡ, [in LXX: 3Ma.1:19 4:5 * ;] a sense of shame, modesty: [[1-timothy 2 9|1Ti.2:9]] (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: αἰσχύνη (see Thayer, 14; Tr., Syn., §xix; Cremer, 611 f.; CGT on I Ti, l.with). (AS)
.*Αἰθίοψ, -οπος, ὁ (αἴθω, to burn, ὤψ, face; i.e. swarthy), [in LXX for כּוּשׁ ;] Ethiopian: [[acts 8 27|Act.8:27.]]† (AS)

αἷμα, ατος, τό, [in LXX for דָּם ;] blood. 1. In the ordinary sense: [[mark 5 25|Mrk.5:25]], [[luke 8 43|Luk.8:43,44 22:44]], [[john 19 34|Jhn.19:34]], [[acts 15 20|Act.15:20,29 21:25]], [[revelation 8 7|Rev.8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13]]. 2. In special senses: (a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): [[john 1 13|Jhn.1:13]] (see MM, VGT, see word); (b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: [[matthew 16 17|Mat.16:17]], [[1-corinthians 15 50|1Co.15:50]], [[galatians 1 16|Gal.1:16]], [[ephesians 6 12|Eph.6:12]], [[hebrews 2 14|Heb.2:14]]; (with) of things in colour resembling blood: [[acts 2 19|Act.2:19,20]], [[revelation 6 12|Rev.6:12 14:18-20]]. (d) of bloodshed, a bloody death (cl.): [[matthew 23 30|Mat.23:30,35 27:4,6,8,24,25]], [[luke 11 50|Luk.11:50,51 13:1]], [[acts 1 19|Act.1:19 5:28 18:6 20:26 22:20]], [[hebrews 12 4|Heb.12:4]], [[revelation 6 10|Rev.6:10 17:6 18:24 19:2]] ; αἷ. ἐκχέειν (Deiss., LAE, 428; MM, VGT, see word, αἷ.), [[romans 3 15|Rom.3:15]], [[revelation 16 6|Rev.16:6]]; (e) of sacrificial blood, as an expiation: [[hebrews 9 7|Heb.9:7,12,13,18-22,25 10:4 11:28 13:11]]; of the blood of Christ, [[matthew 26 28|Mat.26:28]], [[mark 14 24|Mrk.14:24]], [[luke 22 20|Luk.22:20]], [[john 6 53|Jhn.6:53,54,56]], [[acts 20 28|Act.20:28]], [[romans 3 25|Rom.3:25 5:9]], [[1-corinthians 10 16|1Co.10:16 11:25,27]], [[ephesians 1 7|Eph.1:7 2:13]], [[colossians 1 20|Col.1:20]], [[hebrews 9 12|Heb.9:12,14 10:19,29 12:24 13:20]], [[1-peter 1 2|1Pe.1:2,19]], [[1-john 1 7|1Jn.1:7]] ([[1-john 5 6|cf. 5:6,8]]), [[revelation 1 5|Rev.1:5 5:9 7:14 12:11]]. (Cremer, 69 f., 612 f.) † (AS)

αἷμα, ατος, τό, [in LXX for דָּם ;] blood. 1. In the ordinary sense: [[mark 5 25|Mrk.5:25]], [[luke 8 43|Luk.8:43,44 22:44]], [[john 19 34|Jhn.19:34]], [[acts 15 20|Act.15:20,29 21:25]], [[revelation 8 7|Rev.8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13]]. 2. In special senses: (a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): [[john 1 13|Jhn.1:13]] (see MM, VGT, see word); (b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: [[matthew 16 17|Mat.16:17]], [[1-corinthians 15 50|1Co.15:50]], [[galatians 1 16|Gal.1:16]], [[ephesians 6 12|Eph.6:12]], [[hebrews 2 14|Heb.2:14]]; (with) of things in colour resembling blood: [[acts 2 19|Act.2:19,20]], [[revelation 6 12|Rev.6:12 14:18-20]]. (d) of bloodshed, a bloody death (cl.): [[matthew 23 30|Mat.23:30,35 27:4,6,8,24,25]], [[luke 11 50|Luk.11:50,51 13:1]], [[acts 1 19|Act.1:19 5:28 18:6 20:26 22:20]], [[hebrews 12 4|Heb.12:4]], [[revelation 6 10|Rev.6:10 17:6 18:24 19:2]] ; αἷ. ἐκχέειν (Deiss., LAE, 428; MM, VGT, see word, αἷ.), [[romans 3 15|Rom.3:15]], [[revelation 16 6|Rev.16:6]]; (e) of sacrificial blood, as an expiation: [[hebrews 9 7|Heb.9:7,12,13,18-22,25 10:4 11:28 13:11]]; of the blood of Christ, [[matthew 26 28|Mat.26:28]], [[mark 14 24|Mrk.14:24]], [[luke 22 20|Luk.22:20]], [[john 6 53|Jhn.6:53,54,56]], [[acts 20 28|Act.20:28]], [[romans 3 25|Rom.3:25 5:9]], [[1-corinthians 10 16|1Co.10:16 11:25,27]], [[ephesians 1 7|Eph.1:7 2:13]], [[colossians 1 20|Col.1:20]], [[hebrews 9 12|Heb.9:12,14 10:19,29 12:24 13:20]], [[1-peter 1 2|1Pe.1:2,19]], [[1-john 1 7|1Jn.1:7]] ([[1-john 5 6|cf. 5:6,8]]), [[revelation 1 5|Rev.1:5 5:9 7:14 12:11]]. (Cremer, 69 f., 612 f.) † (AS)
αἱματεκχυσία, -ας, ἡ (αἷμα, ἐκ, χέω), shedding of blood (Eccl.; Cremer, 71): [[hebrews 9 22|Heb.9:22.]]† (AS)
αἱμορροέω, (αἷμα, ῥέω), [in LXX: [[leviticus 15 33|Lev.15:33]] (דָּוֶה) * ;] to lose blood, suffer from a flow of blood (Hipp.): [[matthew 9 20|Mat.9:20.]]† (AS)
Αἰνέας, -οῦ, ὁ, Æneas: [[acts 9 33|Act.9:33,34]].† (AS)
αἴνεσις, -εως, ἡ (αἰνέω), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹדָה, תְּהִלָּה ;] praise (Eccl.): θυσία αἰνέσεως ([[leviticus 7 12|Lev.7:12]], זֶבַח תּוֹדָה), [[hebrews 13 15|Heb.13:15.]]† (AS)

αἰνέω, -ῶ (αἶνος), poët., Ion. and late prose (MM, VGT, see word) for cl. ἐπαινέω, [in LXX chiefly for הלל, ידה ;] to praise: with accusative, τ. θεόν, [[luke 2 13|Luk.2:13,20 19:37 24:53]], [[acts 2 47|Act.2:47 3:8,9]], [[romans 15 11|Rom.15:11]]; with dative, τ. Θεῷ ([[jeremiah 20 13|Jer.20:13]], al. for הִלֵּל לְ; see Field, Notes, 245), [[revelation 19 5|Rev.19:5.]]† SYN.: ἐξομολογέω, εὐλογέω, εὐχαριστέω, μακαρίζω (see DCG, i, 211). (AS)

αἴνιγμα, -ατος, τό (αἰνίσσομαι, to speak in riddles; αἰνός = δεινός, dread, strange), [in LXX for חִידָה, [[numbers 12 8|Num.12:8]] and always exc. [[deuteronomy 28 37|Deu.28:37]] (שַׁמָּה) ;] a dark saying, riddle: [[1-corinthians 13 12|1Co.13:12]] (cf. Nu, l.with).† (AS)

αἶνος, ου, ὁ, [in LXX for הלל pi, עֹז ;] poët, and Ion., 1. = μῦθος, a tale (Horn., al.). 2. = Att. ἔπαινος, praise (Horn., al.): [[matthew 21 16|Mat.21:16]] (LXX), [[luke 18 43|Luk.18:43.]] 3. In π., a decree (MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
Αἰνών, ἡ, indecl. (cf. Heb.עַיִן, a spring), Aenon: [[john 3 23|Jhn.3:23.]]† (AS)

αἱρέω, [in LXX for אמר hi., בּחר, etc. ;] to take; Mid., -ομαι (M, Pr., 158 f.; MM, VGT, see word), to choose: [[philippians 1 22|Php.1:22]], [[2-thessalonians 2 13|2Th.2:13]], [[hebrews 11 25|Heb.11:25]]. (Cf. ἀν-, ἀφ-, δι-, ἐξ-, καθ-, περι-, προ-αιρέω.) † (AS)

αἵρεσις, -εως, ἡ (αἱρέω, -ομαι), [in LXX for נְדָבָה,] 1. capture. 2. choosing, choice (see MM, VGT, see word). 3. that which is chosen, hence, opinion; esp. a peculiar opinion, heresy: [[1-corinthians 11 19|1Co.11:19]], [[galatians 5 20|Gal.5:20]], [[2-peter 2 1|2Pe.2:1]] R, txt. 4. In late writers (MM, VGT), of a set of persons professing particular principles or opinions, a school, sect, party, faction: [[acts 5 17|Act.5:17 15:5 24:5,14 26:5 28:22]], I Co, Ga, II Pe, l.with, R, mg. (Cremer, 614). † (AS)
αἱρετίζω, [in LXX chiefly for בּחר (see Cremer, 615) ;] = αἱρέομαι (Hipp., Inscr.), to choose: [[matthew 12 18|Mat.12:18]] (LXX, ἀντιλήμψομαι).† (AS)
αἱρετικός, -ή, όν (αἱρέομαι), 1. capable of choosing (Plat.). 2. causing division, heretical, factious (Cremer, 614): as subst., [[titus 3 10|Tit.3:10.]] † (AS)

αἴρω, [in LXX chiefly for נשׂא, also for לקח, etc. ;] 1. to raise, take up, lift or draw up: [[john 8 59|Jhn.8:59 11:41]], [[acts 27 17|Act.27:17]], al. 2. to bear, carry: [[matthew 4 6|Mat.4:6 16:24]], al. 3. to bear or take away, carry off, remove: [[matthew 21 21|Mat.21:21]], [[john 19 31|Jhn.19:31]], [[1-corinthians 5 12|1Co.5:12 6:15]] (see Lft., Notes, 216), al.; of the taking away sin by Christ, [[john 1 29|Jhn.1:29]], [[1-john 3 5|1Jn.3:5]]. (Cf. ἀπ᾽, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, μετ-, συν-, ὑπερ-αίρω). For exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
αἰσθάνομαι, [in LXX for בּין, חפז, ידע ;] to perceive: withaccusative of thing(s) (Bl., §36, 5; MM, VGT, see word), [[luke 9 45|Luk.9:45]] (Cremer, 619 f.).† (AS)
αἴσθησις, -εως, ἡ (αἰσθάνομαι), [in LXX chiefly for דַּעַת ;] perception (MM, VGT, see word): [[philippians 1 9|Php.1:9.]]† SYN.: ἐπίγνωσις, which see (cf. Cremer, 620). (AS)
αἰσθητήριον, -ου, τό (αἰσθάνομαι), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 4 19|Jer.4:19]] (קִיר), 4Ma.2:22 * ;] sense, organ of perception: [[hebrews 5 14|Heb.5:14]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
αἰσχροκερδής, -ες (αἰσχρός, κέρδος), greedy of base gains: [[1-timothy 3 3|1Ti.3:3]],8 Abbot-Smith omits [[1-timothy 3 3|1Ti.3:3]], [[titus 1 7|Tit.1:7.]]† (AS)
αἰσχροκερδῶς, adv., from eagerness for base gain: [[1-peter 5 2|1Pe.5:2]] (here only).† (AS)
αἰσχρολογία, -ας, ἡ (αἰσχρός, λέγω), abusive language, abuse (Lft., ICC, in l.; MM, VGT, see word): [[colossians 3 8|Col.3:8.]]† (AS)

αἰσχρός, -ά, όν (αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX: [[genesis 41 3|Gen.41:3]] ff. (רַע, רֹעַ), Jdth.12:12, al. ;] base, shameful: [[1-corinthians 11 6|1Co.11:6 14:35]], [[ephesians 5 12|Eph.5:12]], [[titus 1 11|Tit.1:11]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

αἰσχρός, -ά, όν (αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX: [[genesis 41 3|Gen.41:3]] ff. (רַע, רֹעַ), Jdth.12:12, al. ;] base, shameful: [[1-corinthians 11 6|1Co.11:6 14:35]], [[ephesians 5 12|Eph.5:12]], [[titus 1 11|Tit.1:11]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
αἰσχρότης, -τητος, ἡ (αἰσχρός), baseness: [[ephesians 5 4|Eph.5:4.]]† (AS)

αἰσχύνη, -ης, ἡ (αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX chiefly for בּשֶׁת ;] shame (MM, VGT, see word): subjectively, [[luke 14 19|Luk.14:19]], [[2-corinthians 4 2|2Co.4:2]]; objectively, [[philippians 3 19|Php.3:19]], [[hebrews 12 2|Heb.12:2]]; as something to be ashamed of, [[revelation 3 18|Rev.3:18;]] pl. (Bl., §32, 6), shameful deeds, Ju 13.† SYN.: αἰδώς, which see (AS)

αἰσχύνω (αἶσχος, shame), [in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ ;] 1. to disfigure (Hom.). 2. to dishonour ([[proverbs 29 15|Pro.29:15]]). 3. to make ashamed (Sir.13:7). Pass., to be put to shame, be ashamed: [[2-corinthians 10 8|2Co.10:8;]] [[philippians 1 20|Php.1:20]], [[1-peter 4 16|1Pe.4:16]], [[1-john 2 28|1Jn.2:28]]; with inf. (M, Pr., 205), [[luke 16 3|Luk.16:3]] (cf. ἐπ- (-ομαι), κατ- αἰσχύνω). † (AS)

αἰτέω, -ῶ, [in LXX chiefly for שׁאל ;] to ask, request: absol., [[matthew 7 7|Mat.7:7]], [[james 1 6|Jas.1:6]]; with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 5 42|Mat.5:42]], [[luke 6 30|Luk.6:30]]; with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, [[matthew 20 20|Mat.20:20]], [[1-john 5 15|1Jn.5:15]]; id. before παρά, [[acts 3 2|Act.3:2]], [[james 1 5|Jas.1:5]]; with dupl. accusative [[matthew 7 9|Mat.7:9]], [[mark 6 22|Mrk.6:22]], [[john 16 23|Jhn.16:23]]. Mid. (on the distinction bet. mid. and act., see M, Pr., 160): absol., [[mark 15 8|Mrk.15:8]], [[john 16 26|Jhn.16:26]], [[james 4 3|Jas.4:3]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 14 7|Mat.14:7]], [[mark 6 24|Mrk.6:24]], al.; with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 27 20|Mat.27:20]], [[luke 23 25|Luk.23:25]]; with accusative of thing(s), before παρά, [[acts 9 2|Act.9:2;]] with accusative and inf., [[luke 23 23|Luk.23:23.]] with inf. [[acts 7 46|Act.7:46]], [[ephesians 3 13|Eph.3:13]] (cf. ἀπ-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, παρ-, προσ- αιτέω). SYN.: ἐρωτάω, which see, πυνθάνομαι. On the proper distinction between these words, see Tr., Syn., § xl, Thayer, see word αἰ. In late Gk., however, αἰ. and ἐ. seem to have become practically synonymous (cf. [[acts 3 2|Act.3:2]],3; see Field, Notes, 101 f.; M, Th., I, 4:1; M, Pr., 66.n; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

αἴτημα, -ατος, τό (αἰτέω), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁאֵלָה ;] that which has been asked for, a petition, request: [[luke 23 24|Luk.23:24]], [[philippians 4 6|Php.4:6]], [[john 5 15|Jhn.5:15]].† SYN.: see: δέησις. (AS)

αἰτία, -ας, ἡ, [in LXX: [[genesis 4 13|Gen.4:13]] (עָוֹן), [[proverbs 28 17|Pro.28:17]] (עָשַׁק), and frequently in Wi, II, III Mac ;] 1. cause, reason, occasion, case: [[matthew 19 3|Mat.19:3]], [[luke 8 47|Luk.8:47]], [[acts 10 21|Act.10:21 22:24 28:20]], [[2-timothy 1 6|2Ti.1:6,12]], [[titus 1 13|Tit.1:13]], [[hebrews 2 11|Heb.2:11]] ; εἰ οὕτως ἐστιν ἡ αἰ. (cf. Lat. si ita res se habet, and see MM. VGT, see word), [[matthew 19 10|Mat.19:10.]] 2. In forensic sense, (a) accusation: [[acts 25 18|Act.25:18,27]]; (b) cause for punishment, crime: [[matthew 27 37|Mat.27:37]], [[mark 15 26|Mrk.15:26]], [[john 18 38|Jhn.18:38 19:4,6]], [[acts 13 28|Act.13:28 23:28 28:18]]. † SYN.: ἔλεγχος, a charge, whether moral or judicial, which has been proven, αἰ. is an accusation simply, false or true. (AS)
αἰτίωμα (Rec. αἰτίαμα, the usual form; see MM, VGT, see word), -τος, τό (αἰτιάομαι, αἰτία), a charge, accusation: [[acts 25 7|Act.25:7.]]† (AS)

αἴτιον, -ου, τό, see: αἴτιος. αἴτιος, -α, ὁ (αἰτία), [in LXX: [[1-samuel 22 22|1Ki.22:22]] (סבב) Dan LXX Bel 41, TH ib. 42, Su 53, 2Ma.4:47 13:4, 4Ma.1:11 * ;] 1. causative of, responsible for; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the cause, author: [[hebrews 5 9|Heb.5:9;]] τὸ αἰ., the cause, [[acts 19 40|Act.19:40.]] 2. blameworthy, culpable; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the culprit, the accused (Lat. reus); τὸ αἰ. (= αἰτία, 3), the crime, [[luke 23 4|Luk.23:4,14,22]]. † (AS)

αἴτιος, -α, ὁ (αἰτία), [in LXX: [[1-samuel 22 22|1Ki.22:22]] (סבב) Dan LXX Bel 41, TH ib. 42, Su 53, 2Ma.4:47 13:4, 4Ma.1:11 * ;] 1. causative of, responsible for; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the cause, author: [[hebrews 5 9|Heb.5:9;]] τὸ αἰ., the cause, [[acts 19 40|Act.19:40.]] 2. blameworthy, culpable; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the culprit, the accused (Lat. reus); τὸ αἰ. (= αἰτία, 3), the crime, [[luke 23 4|Luk.23:4,14,22]]. † (AS)

αἰφνίδιος (in Lk, l.with, ἐφν- WH; see M, Pr., 35), -ον (αἴφνης = ἄφνως, suddenly), [in LXX: Wis.17:15, 2Ma.14:17, 3Ma.3:24 * ;] sudden, unexpected: [[luke 21 34|Luk.21:34]], [[1-thessalonians 5 3|1Th.5:3]].† (AS)

αἰχμαλωσία -ας, ἡ (αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁבִי, גּוֹלָה ;] captivity (Diod., al.): [[revelation 13 10|Rev.13:10;]] pl., abstr. for concr., = αἰχμάλωτοι, [[ephesians 4 8|Eph.4:8]] (LXX).† (AS)
αἰχμαλωτεύω (αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבה ;] = αἰχμαλωτίζω, which see, to lead captive: [[ephesians 4 8|Eph.4:8]] (LXX).† (AS)

αἰχμαλωτίζω (αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבה ;] in late writers = cl. αἰχμάλωτον ποιῶ (ἄγω), to take or lead captive: before εἰς, [[luke 21 24|Luk.21:24]] (cf. Tob.1:10); metaphorically, [[romans 7 23|Rom.7:23]], [[2-corinthians 10 5|2Co.10:5]], [[2-timothy 3 6|2Ti.3:6]].† (AS)
αἰχμάλωτος, -ον (αἰχμή, a spear, ἁλίσκομαι, to be taken), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁבָה, גּוֹלָה ;] captive: [[luke 4 18|Luk.4:18]] (LXX).† (AS)

αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for עַד ,עוֹלָם ;] 1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT); (a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), [[luke 1 70|Luk.1:70;]] (b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, [[matthew 21 19|Mat.21:19;]] id., with neg., never, [[john 4 14|Jhn.4:14;]] more strongly, εἰς τὸν αἰ. τοῦ αἰ., [[hebrews 1 8|Heb.1:8]] (LXX); εἰς τοὺς αἰ., [[matthew 6 13|Mat.6:13;]] εἰς τοὺς αἰ. τῶν αἰ. (cf. [[isaiah 45 17|Isa.45:17]], עַד־עוֹלְמֵי עַד), [[romans 16 27|Rom.16:27]], LT; cf. also [[ephesians 3 21|Eph.3:21]], [[2-peter 3 18|2Pe.3:18]], Ju 25, [[revelation 14 11|Rev.14:11]]. 2. οἱ αἰ., the worlds, the universe, "the sum of the periods of time, including all that is manifested in them": He :12 11:3 (cf. [[1-timothy 1 17|1Ti.1:17]], where τῶν αἰ. are prob. "the ages or world-periods which when summed up make eternity". 3. the present age (Heb. הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה): ὁ αἰ., [[matthew 13 22|Mat.13:22;]] ὁ αἰ. οὗτος, [[matthew 12 32|Mat.12:32;]] ὁ νῦν αἰ., [[1-timothy 6 17|1Ti.6:17;]] ὁ ἐνεστὼς αἰ., [[galatians 1 4|Gal.1:4;]] similarly, of the time after Christ's second coming (הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא), ὁ αἰ. ἐκεῖνος, [[luke 20 35|Luk.20:35;]] ὁ αἰ. μέλλων, [[matthew 12 32|Mat.12:32;]] ὁ αἰ. ὁ ἐρχόμενος, [[mark 10 30|Mrk.10:30.]] SYN.: κόσμος, the ordered universe, the scheme of material things; οἰκουμένη, the inhabited earth; in contrast with both of which αἰ. is the world under aspects of time (cf. Westc. on [[hebrews 1 2|Heb.1:2;]] Tr., Syn., §lix; Thayer, see word, αἰ.; Cremer, 74, 620; MM, VGT). (AS)

αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for עַד ,עוֹלָם ;] 1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT); (a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), [[luke 1 70|Luk.1:70;]] (b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, [[matthew 21 19|Mat.21:19;]] id., with neg., never, [[john 4 14|Jhn.4:14;]] more strongly, εἰς τὸν αἰ. τοῦ αἰ., [[hebrews 1 8|Heb.1:8]] (LXX); εἰς τοὺς αἰ., [[matthew 6 13|Mat.6:13;]] εἰς τοὺς αἰ. τῶν αἰ. (cf. [[isaiah 45 17|Isa.45:17]], עַד־עוֹלְמֵי עַד), [[romans 16 27|Rom.16:27]], LT; cf. also [[ephesians 3 21|Eph.3:21]], [[2-peter 3 18|2Pe.3:18]], Ju 25, [[revelation 14 11|Rev.14:11]]. 2. οἱ αἰ., the worlds, the universe, "the sum of the periods of time, including all that is manifested in them": He :12 11:3 (cf. [[1-timothy 1 17|1Ti.1:17]], where τῶν αἰ. are prob. "the ages or world-periods which when summed up make eternity". 3. the present age (Heb. הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה): ὁ αἰ., [[matthew 13 22|Mat.13:22;]] ὁ αἰ. οὗτος, [[matthew 12 32|Mat.12:32;]] ὁ νῦν αἰ., [[1-timothy 6 17|1Ti.6:17;]] ὁ ἐνεστὼς αἰ., [[galatians 1 4|Gal.1:4;]] similarly, of the time after Christ's second coming (הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא), ὁ αἰ. ἐκεῖνος, [[luke 20 35|Luk.20:35;]] ὁ αἰ. μέλλων, [[matthew 12 32|Mat.12:32;]] ὁ αἰ. ὁ ἐρχόμενος, [[mark 10 30|Mrk.10:30.]] SYN.: κόσμος, the ordered universe, the scheme of material things; οἰκουμένη, the inhabited earth; in contrast with both of which αἰ. is the world under aspects of time (cf. Westc. on [[hebrews 1 2|Heb.1:2;]] Tr., Syn., §lix; Thayer, see word, αἰ.; Cremer, 74, 620; MM, VGT). (AS)

αἰώνιος, -ον (as usual in Attic), also -α, -ον. [[2-thessalonians 2 16|2Th.2:16]], [[hebrews 9 12|Heb.9:12]]; (αἰών), [in LXX chiefly for עוֹלָם ;] age-long, eternal, (a) of that which is without either beginning or end: [[romans 16 26|Rom.16:26]], [[hebrews 9 14|Heb.9:14]]; (b) of that which is without beginning: [[romans 16 25|Rom.16:25]], [[2-timothy 1 9|2Ti.1:9]], [[titus 1 2|Tit.1:2]]; (with) of that which is without end (MM, VGT, see word): σκηναί, [[luke 16 9|Luk.16:9]] οἰκία, [[2-corinthians 5 1|2Co.5:1;]] διαθήκη, [[hebrews 13 20|Heb.13:20;]] εὐαγγέλιον, [[revelation 14 6|Rev.14:6;]] παράκλησις, [[2-thessalonians 2 16|2Th.2:16;]] λύτρωσις, [[hebrews 9 12|Heb.9:12;]] κληρονομία, ib. 15; κόλασις, [[matthew 25 46|Mat.25:46;]] κρίμα, [[hebrews 6 2|Heb.6:2;]] κρίσις, [[mark 3 29|Mrk.3:29;]] ὄλεθρον, [[2-thessalonians 1 9|2Th.1:9;]] πῦρ, [[matthew 18 8|Mat.18:8;]] frequently with ζωή, which see SYN.: ἀΐδιος, which see (AS)

ἀκαθαρσία, -ας, ἡ (ἀκάθαρτος), [in LXX chiefly for טֻמְאָה, טָמֵא ;] uncleanness, impurity, (a) physical (MM, VGT, see word): [[matthew 23 27|Mat.23:27;]] (b) moral: [[romans 1 24|Rom.1:24 6:19]], [[2-corinthians 12 21|2Co.12:21]], [[galatians 5 19|Gal.5:19]], [[ephesians 4 19|Eph.4:19 5:3]], [[colossians 3 5|Col.3:5]], [[1-thessalonians 2 3|1Th.2:3 4:7]]. † (AS)
ἀκαθάρτης, -τος, ἡ, uncleanness: [[revelation 17 4|Rev.17:4]], Rec. (for τ. ἀκάθαρτα).† (AS)

ἀκάθαρτος, -ον (ἀ- neg., καθαίρω), [in LXX chiefly for טָמֵא ;] unclean, impure; (a) physically (LS, MM, VGT, see word); (b) ceremonially: [[acts 10 14|Act.10:14,28 11:8]], [[1-corinthians 7 14|1Co.7:14]], [[2-corinthians 6 17|2Co.6:17]], [[revelation 18 2|Rev.18:2]]; (with) morally: [[ephesians 5 5|Eph.5:5]], [[revelation 17 4|Rev.17:4]]; with πνεῦμα, as always in Gosp., [[matthew 10 1|Mat.10:1 12:43]], [[mark 1 23|Mrk.1:23,26,27 3:11,30 5:2,8,13 6:7 7:25 9:25]], [[luke 4 33|Luk.4:33,36 6:18 8:29 9:42 11:24]], [[acts 5 16|Act.5:16 8:7]], [[revelation 16 13|Rev.16:13]] (cf. Cremer, 320). † (AS)
ἀκαιρέομαι, -οῦμαι (ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), to have no opportunity (opposite to εὐκαιρέω): [[philippians 4 10|Php.4:10.]]† (AS)
ἀκαίρως, adv. (ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), [in LXX: Si 35 (32):4 * ;] out of season, unseasonably: opposite to εὐκαίρως (which see), [[2-timothy 4 2|2Ti.4:2]] (cf. Cremer, 740; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἄκακος, -ον, [in LXX for פְּתִי, תָּם, etc. ;] (a) as in cl. (Æsch., Plat., al.), of persons, simple, guileless: [[romans 16 18|Rom.16:18]], [[hebrews 7 26|Heb.7:26]] (cf. Cremer, 327); (b) of things, undamaged (? MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

ἄκανθα, -ης, ἡ (ἀκή, a point), [in LXX chiefly for קוֹץ, also for סִיר, שַׁיִת, etc. ;] a prickly plant, thorn, brier; in NT always pl.: [[matthew 7 16|Mat.7:16 13:7,22 27:29]], [[mark 4 7|Mrk.4:7,18]], [[luke 6 44|Luk.6:44 8:7,14]], [[john 19 2|Jhn.19:2]], [[hebrews 6 8|Heb.6:8]] (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀκάνθινος, -ον (ἄκανθα), [in LXX: [[isaiah 34 13|Isa.34:13]] (סיר) * ;] 1. of thorns: [[mark 15 17|Mrk.15:17]], [[john 19 5|Jhn.19:5]]. 2. of acantha-wood (Hdt.; π. ap. MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

ἄ-καρπος, -ον, [in LXX: [[jeremiah 2 6|Jer.2:6]] (צַלְמָוֶת), Wis.15:4, 4Ma.16:7 ;] unfruitful, barren: figuratively, [[matthew 13 22|Mat.13:22]], [[mark 4 19|Mrk.4:19]], [[1-corinthians 14 14|1Co.14:14]], [[ephesians 5 11|Eph.5:11]], [[titus 3 14|Tit.3:14]], [[2-peter 1 8|2Pe.1:8]], Ju 12.† (AS)
ἀ-κατά-γνωστος, -ον (καταγινώσκω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:47 ;] not open to just rebuke, irreprehensible: [[titus 2 8|Tit.2:8]] (see Cremer, 676; and for other exx., MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀ-κατα-κάλυπτος, -ον (κατακαλύπτω), [in LXX: [[leviticus 13 45|Lev.13:45]] A (פָּרוּע) * ;] uncovered, unveiled: [[1-corinthians 11 5|1Co.11:5, 13]].† (AS)
ἀ-κατά-κριτος, -ον (κατακρίνω), 1. uncondemned (EV): [[acts 16 37|Act.16:37, 22:25]]. 2. = cl. ἄκριτος, without trial, not yet tried (MM, VGT, see word) Ac, ll. cc. † (AS)
ἀ-κατά-λυτος, -ον (καταλύω), [in LXX: 4Ma.10:11 * ;] indissoluble: [[hebrews 7 16|Heb.7:16.]]† (AS)
ἀκατάπαυστος, -ον (καταπαύω), that cannot cease, not to be restrained: with genitive of thing(s), [[2-peter 2 14|2Pe.2:14]], T, Tr. txt.† (AS)

ἀκαταστασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀκατάστατος), [in LXX: [[proverbs 26 28|Pro.26:28]] (מִדְחֶה), Tob.4:13 * ;] instability (MM, VGT, see word); hence, confusion, tumult: [[1-corinthians 14 33|1Co.14:33]], [[james 3 16|Jas.3:16]]; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), [[luke 21 9|Luk.21:9]], [[2-corinthians 6 5|2Co.6:5, 12:20]] (Polyb., al.; see Cremer, 739).† (AS)
ἀ-κατά-στατος, -ον (καθίστημι), [in LXX: [[isaiah 54 11|Isa.54:11]] (סֹעֲרָה) ;] unsettled, unstable: [[james 1 8|Jas.1:8, 3:8]].† (AS)
ἀκατάσχετος, -ον (κατέχω), [in LXX: [[job 31 11|Job.31:11]], 3Ma.6:17 * ;] that cannot be restrained: [[james 3 8|Jas.3:8]] Rec. (for -στατος, which see).† (AS)
§ Akeldama dama (Proper name) (traditionally located south of the valley of Hinnom), "field of blood"

ἀκέραιος, -ον (κεράννυμι), [in LXX: [[esther 8 13|Est.8:13]] * ;] unmixed, pure, hence, metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), guileless, simple: [[matthew 10 16|Mat.10:16]], [[romans 16 19|Rom.16:19]], [[philippians 2 15|Php.2:15]].† SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἁπλοῦς (cf. Ellic. on Phl., l.with; Tr., Syn., §lvi). (AS)
ἀκλινής, -ές (κλίνω), [in LXX: 4Ma.6:7 17:3 * ;] unbending, firm: metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word). [[hebrews 10 23|Heb.10:23.]]† (AS)
ἀκμάζω (ἀκμήν), [in LXX: 4Ma.2:3 * ;] to be at the prime; of produce of the ground, to be ripe (Thuc.): [[revelation 14 18|Rev.14:18]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀκμήν, accusative of ἀκμή, a point, used as adv., at the present point of time, even now, even yet: [[matthew 15 16|Mat.15:16.]]† (AS)

ἀκοή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀκούω), [in LXX: [[exodus 15 26|Exo.15:26]], al. for שׁמע, its parts and derivatives, exc. [[deuteronomy 11 22|Deu.11:22]] (שׁמר) ;] 1. hearing, the sense of hearing: [[1-corinthians 12 17|1Co.12:17]], [[2-peter 2 8|2Pe.2:8]]; "Hebraic dative," ἀκοῇ ακούειν (frequently in LXX; V. M, Pr., 14, 75), [[matthew 13 14|Mat.13:14]], [[acts 28 26|Act.28:26]]. 2. organ of hearing, the ear (Arist., al.; MM, VGT, see word): [[2-timothy 4 3|2Ti.4:3-4]]; pl., [[mark 7 35|Mrk.7:35]], [[luke 7 1|Luk.7:1]], [[acts 17 20|Act.17:20]], [[hebrews 5 11|Heb.5:11]]. 3. a thing heard, i.e., (a) a message, teaching: [[john 12 38|Jhn.12:38]] and [[romans 16 16|Rom.16:16,17]]" (LXX), [[galatians 3 2|Gal.3:2]],5 R, mg.; λόγος ἀκοῆς, [[1-thessalonians 2 13|1Th.2:13]], [[hebrews 4 2|Heb.4:2]]; (b) a report, rumour: with genitive, of person(s), [[matthew 4 24|Mat.4:24, 14:1, 24:6]]; [[mark 1 28|Mrk.1:28 13:7]] (Cremer, 82, 623; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀκολουθέω, -ῶ (ἀκόλουθος, following; ἀ- cop., κέλευθος, poët., away), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;] to accompany, follow: [[matthew 4 25|Mat.4:25]], al. Metaphorical, of discipleship: [[matthew 9 9|Mat.9:9]], [[mark 9 38|Mrk.9:38]], [[john 12 26|Jhn.12:26]], al. Absol.: [[matthew 18 10|Mat.18:10;]] more freq., with dative (cl.), [[matthew 8 1|Mat.8:1]], al.; before μετά, with genitive, (cl.; Eutherford, N.Phr., 458 f.), [[luke 9 49|Luk.9:49;]] ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אָהֲרֵי), [[matthew 10 38|Mat.10:38]] (cf. ἐξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-, παρ-, συν-ἀκολουθέω). SYN.: (cl.) ἕπομαι, not in NT (see Cremer, 80; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

ἀκούω, [in LXX chiefly for שׁמע ] to hear, listen, attend, perceive by hearing, comprehend by hearing. 1. Intrans.: [[mark 4 3|Mrk.4:3 7:37]], [[james 2 5|Jas.2:5]], [[revelation 2 7|Rev.2:7]], al.; τ. ὠσίν, [[matthew 13 15|Mat.13:15]] (LXX); with cogn. dative, ακοῇ ἀ. (see: ἀκοή), [[matthew 13 14|Mat.13:14]], [[acts 28 26|Act.28:26]]" (LXX) ; ὁ ἔχων ὦτα (οὖς) ἀκούειν, ἀκουσάτω, [[matthew 11 15|Mat.11:15]], [[mark 4 23|Mrk.4:23]], [[revelation 2 7|Rev.2:7]], al. 2. Trans., prop. with accusative of thing(s), of thing heard, genitive of person(s), from whom heard (LS, see word): [[acts 1 4|Act.1:4;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 12 19|Mat.12:19]], [[john 3 8|Jhn.3:8]] (Abbott, JG, 76), [[acts 22 9|Act.22:9]], al.; with dupl. accusative, [[john 12 18|Jhn.12:18]], [[1-corinthians 11 18|1Co.11:18]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[john 7 40|Jhn.7:40]] (Abbott, JV, 116); τ. φωνῆς (cf.
